edits.text: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. One account tentatively identifies the oracle-bone name as 火星; other accounts identify it as 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’. The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. One account tentatively calls the star 火星, while others identify it as 大火/心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how the star name relates to ‘fire’.
